name: Navarre
summary: A red field with the arms of Navarre: gold chains forming a cross and saltire, with an emerald at the centre, under a royal crown.
origin: According to tradition, the chains commemorate those broken by King Sancho VII at the Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212. A laurel wreath added under Franco was removed in 1981.

symbols.name: Chains
symbols.description: Gold chains forming an eight-pointed pattern.
symbols.meaning: By legend, the chains protecting the Almohad caliph's tent, broken by Sancho VII in 1212.

facts: Pamplona's San Fermín festival and bull run are in Navarre.
Navarre was an independent kingdom until 1512.
clues: Gold chains with an emerald under a crown, on red.
Its chains are linked by legend to a battle in 1212.
The region of the running of the bulls.
